x: 禹之子启确立世袭，「家天下」开端（约）
xEn: Qi, son of Yu, established hereditary rule — the start of “family rule” (approx.).

x: 汤建商，甲骨文为中国最早的成熟文字
xEn: Tang founds Shang; oracle bone script is China's earliest mature writing.

tEn: Battle of Muye · Rise of Zhou
x: 武王伐纣，商亡周立，行分封
xEn: King Wu defeats Zhou, Shang falls and Zhou rises, enfeoffment begins.

x: 国人暴动，中国确切纪年之始
xEn: Commoner revolt; the start of China's precise chronology.

x: 东周开始，春秋争霸拉开序幕
xEn: Eastern Zhou begins; the Spring and Autumn contending lords opens.

x: 嬴政称皇帝，废分封行郡县
xEn: Ying Zheng claims the imperial title; abolishes feudalism for commanderies.

tEn: Uprising of Chen Sheng & Wu Guang
x: 中国历史上第一次大规模农民起义
xEn: The first large-scale peasant uprising in Chinese history.

x: 刘邦称帝，开两汉四百年
xEn: Liu Bang becomes emperor, opening the four-century Han.

tEn: Zhang Qian reaches the Western Regions
x: 丝绸之路开辟
xEn: The Silk Road is opened.

x: 纸张普及，知识传播革命
xEn: Paper spreads; a revolution in knowledge transmission.

x: 东汉动摇，群雄并起
xEn: Eastern Han shaken; heroes rise across the land.

x: 曹操破袁绍，统一北方奠基
xEn: Cao Cao defeats Yuan Shao, laying the base to unite the north.

x: 孙刘联军破曹，三分格局初成
xEn: Sun–Liu coalition breaks Cao Cao; the tripartite pattern forms.

x: 东汉灭亡，三国时代开始
xEn: Eastern Han ends; the Three Kingdoms era begins.

x: 结束三国分裂，短暂统一
xEn: Ends the Three Kingdoms split; brief unification.

x: 东晋建立，士族南迁
xEn: Eastern Jin founded; the gentry clans migrate south.

x: 东晋以少胜多，前秦崩溃
xEn: Eastern Jin wins outnumbered; Former Qin collapses.

x: 结束南北分裂，重归一统
xEn: Ends the north–south split; realm restored to unity.

x: 贯通南北，影响千年漕运
xEn: Links north and south; shapes a millennium of grain transport.

x: 李渊建唐，中国进入盛世
xEn: Li Yuan founds Tang; China enters its golden age.

x: 李世民即位，开启贞观之治
xEn: Li Shimin takes the throne, opening the Zhenguan era.

x: 唐由盛转衰的转折点
xEn: The turning point of Tang's decline from prosperity.

x: 朱温代唐，中原进入五代更替
xEn: Zhu Wen replaces Tang; the Central Plains enter the Five Dynasties.

x: 宋辽议和，长期对峙格局形成
xEn: Song–Liao peace; a long standoff pattern forms.

x: 金灭北宋，宋室南渡
xEn: Jin destroys Northern Song; the Song court flees south.

x: 蒙古崛起，开启征服扩张
xEn: Mongols rise, beginning conquest and expansion.

x: 南宋灭亡，元统一全国
xEn: Southern Song falls; Yuan unifies the realm.

x: 远航西洋，规模空前
xEn: Voyages to the Western Oceans, on an unprecedented scale.

x: 清朝前身崛起于东北
xEn: The Qing precursor rises in the Northeast.

tEn: Ming falls · Qing enters the pass
x: 明清易代，清定鼎中原
xEn: Dynastic change; Qing settles the Central Plains.

x: 中国近代史开端
xEn: The beginning of modern Chinese history.

x: 帝制终结，两千余年王朝史落幕
xEn: Imperial rule ends; two millennia of dynasty history closes.
